fluff.overview: Federated Suns infantry benefit from one of the strongest industrial bases in the Inner Sphere, with AFFS quartermasters able to supply platoons with standardized equipment and ammunition from a logistics network that few rival states can match. Mechanized tracked platoons ride armored personnel carriers that provide both protection and all-terrain mobility, allowing these troops to keep pace with armored advances across open ground and survive the indirect fire that scatters lighter formations. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
